rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose choice for sophisticated systems or technology when the emphasis is on complexity.

example.english: This new system is so sophisticated that even the technicians need to read the manual.
example.traditional: 呢套新系統複雜到，連技術員都要睇說明書。
example.jyutping: nei1 tou3 san1 hai6 tung2 fuk1 zaap6 dou3 lin4 gei6 seot6 jyun4 dou1 jiu3 tai2 syut3 ming4 syu1

rows.note: Use this for a person who is worldly-wise and no longer naive, sometimes with a slightly negative tone.

example.english: After so many years out in the world, they’re really sophisticated.
example.traditional: 佢行走江湖咁多年，個人真係好世故。
example.jyutping: keoi5 hang4 zau2 gong1 wu4 gam3 do1 nin4 go3 jan4 zan1 hai6 hou2 sai3 gu3

rows.note: Use this for art, objects, or people that show cultured, refined taste rather than worldly experience or technical complexity.

example.english: This home has a sophisticated interior that looks luxurious without being flashy.
example.traditional: 呢間屋裝修得好有品味，睇落高級但唔浮誇。
example.jyutping: ne1 gaan1 uk1 zong1 sau1 dak1 hou2 jau5 ban2 mei6 tai2 lok6 gou1 kap1 daan6 m4 fau4 kwaa1
